properties.comment:
Absorption length is caculated using transmittance values for 2 mm thickness (crystan standard UV grade) from https://www.crystran.co.uk/optical-materials/sapphire-al2o3
F = ((n - 1) * (n - 1)) / ((n + 1) * (n + 1))
Absorption length = (-1 / ln(transmittance + 2*F)) * 2 mm
where: F - Fresnel reflection coefficient n - Refractive index of Sapphire
